notablePrerequisites: Lesser Masticore does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
description:
Activate The Golden Throne by tapping it and sacrificing Lesser Masticore, adding three mana of any color(s).
When Lesser Masticore dies, its persist ability and Dross Scorpion trigger.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping The Golden Throne.
Resolve the Lesser Masticore trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with no -1/-1 counters on it due to Vizier of Remedies.
Repeat.
